site_audit.html_errors: 21 errors, 81 warnings, 104 info on the homepage. Errors include: two p end tags with no p element in scope; six bad xmlns values (https:// where http:// is required); a stray div end tag; a style element in body that is not its parent's first child; six style rules outside an @scope rule; and five heading-level skips (h3 after h1, h6 after h2 twice, h5 after h2, h5 after h3). Warnings include 68 redundant type attributes on JavaScript resources, nine on style elements, a warning that more than one h1 is in use, and three sections with no heading.

issues: Your live ad promises a '5-Year Warranty' and the homepage repeats '5 Years Product Warranty', but your own FAQ on /contacts/ says 'We offer 12-24 months warranty depending on the model'.
Both live ads point at instagram.com/microb_energies, so nobody who clicks an ad about a 5HP pump at Siddipet reaches microbenergies.com.

Three homepage links go to the wrong page: 'Solar Water Pump Inverter / Controller' to /services/heat-pump/, 'Zero Fuel Cost' to /services/projecting-4/, 'Rooftop Solar' to /services/diagnostic-and-repair/.
The 'Power Your Future with Rooftop Solar' block reuses the agricultural copy word for word.
The contact form has no email field at all, and the testimonials heading is spelled 'Cilent Testimonials'.

site_evidence.note: Landing-page source read live on 2026-11-10 through the W3C Nu HTML Checker (validator.w3.org/nu/?doc=<url>&showsource=yes), which returns the served HTML with script tags intact, plus a direct fetch of the same pages. Tags found: GA4 / Google tag.

promise_gap: Ad: '300 FT DEEP. 5 HP POWER. BUILT FOR PERFORMANCE. Another successful installation at Siddipet, Telangana! ... 5HP Solar Water Pumping System, designed to deliver reliable water pumping even at a depth of 300 feet.'

The site backs the product: /solar-water-pump-controllers/ covers 1HP-10HP MPPT controllers with dry-run protection, and the FAQ gives panel sizing for 1 HP (~1.2 kW), 3 HP (~3.5 kW) and 5 HP (~5.5 kW). What the site does not back is the warranty. The ad says '5-Year Warranty' and the homepage says '5 Years Product Warranty', but the FAQ on /contacts/ says 'We offer 12-24 months warranty depending on the model' - and separately gives the controller's *lifespan* as '5 years or more'. The ad has turned a lifespan figure into a warranty promise.
Ad destination: instagram.com/microb_energies, on both live ads.

The website is far the stronger asset: a fifteen-question FAQ, efficiency and protection specifications, hybrid solar-plus-grid models, optional GSM/IoT monitoring, and a 'Get a Free Solar Project Consultation' CTA. None of it is reachable from the ad.
Ad: 'MICROB ENERGIES. Engineered for Performance. Designed for Reliability. Designed. Engineered. Manufactured in India.'

The site does claim an in-house manufacturing facility in Hyderabad and MNRE certification. But three of the homepage's own service links point at the wrong pages - /services/heat-pump/, /services/projecting-4/ and /services/diagnostic-and-repair/ - so a visitor who tries to read about the product is sent to a heat-pump or a repair page instead.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
